Read a Pinnacle 21 Report from Disk

Source: R/read_p21_report.R
read_p21_report.Rd

Loads a Pinnacle 21 validation report (the export most teams already produce for every submission) into a data.frame, ready for p21_to_evidence(). CSV exports are read with base R. Excel exports are read with the readxl package when it is installed; if it is not, export the report as CSV instead.

Usage

read_p21_report(path, format = c("auto", "csv", "xlsx"), sheet = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the report file.

format

One of "auto" (infer from the file extension), "csv", or "xlsx". Default "auto".

sheet

For Excel reports, the sheet to read. When NULL (the default), a sheet whose name looks like the findings list (matching "detail", "issue", or "finding") is used, otherwise the first sheet.

Value

A data.frame of the report rows with the original column names.

Details

This function only reads the file; it does not interpret the columns. Pass the result to p21_to_evidence(), which detects the rule, message, severity, dataset, variable, and result columns case-insensitively.

See also

p21_to_evidence() to convert the result into evidence.

Examples

# Simulate a small CSV export and read it back.
p21 <- data.frame(
  "Rule ID" = c("SD0001", "SD0002"),
  Message   = c("Missing variable label", "Invalid format"),
  Severity  = c("Error", "Warning"),
  Dataset   = c("ADSL", "ADAE"),
  Variable  = c("AGEU", "AESEQ"),
  Status    = c("Failed", "Warning"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
csv <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
utils::write.csv(p21, csv, row.names = FALSE)
report <- read_p21_report(csv)
#> ℹ Read 2 rows from /tmp/RtmpgpF09e/file1b097ba047d6.csv
report
#>   Rule ID                Message Severity Dataset Variable  Status
#> 1  SD0001 Missing variable label    Error    ADSL     AGEU  Failed
#> 2  SD0002         Invalid format  Warning    ADAE    AESEQ Warning
